products.name: Duka
products.pitch: Customers order from your site, you deliver across town, and only sellers you've checked get listed. You run it all from a private admin.
products.for: Shops, thrift sellers, kitchens and anyone selling in Nairobi

proof.label: sosick.odhis.co.ke
proof.note: Running for a Nairobi thrift brand

features: Pickup and delivery orders
Customers choose pickup or delivery and order straight from your site, with no app to install.
Verified sellers
Sellers are listed only after you check them. Strangers can't sign themselves up, so the badge means something.
Private admin
Orders, team, charges and sellers in one place, behind your own sign-in.
Fees you control
Delivery and extra fees switch on and off from the admin. Nothing is hard-coded.
A built-in helper
A friendly helper answers common questions and walks customers through ordering. It follows set rules, not guesswork.
Private by design
Customer data is locked to you and your team, with a privacy page written for Kenya's Data Protection Act.
faq: Do I need my own web address?
No. You can start on a free address and move to your own .co.ke later. A domain usually costs around a thousand to fifteen hundred shillings a year.
Can sellers sign up by themselves?
No, on purpose. You add each seller after checking them, which is what keeps customers trusting the badge.
Can customers pay with M-PESA?
It doesn't take payments today. Orders are confirmed with you directly. M-PESA checkout can be added as a custom build.
What does it cost?
It depends on what you need, so every price is a quote. Message us on WhatsApp and you'll get a clear number before any work starts.

products.name: The Office
products.line: Your clients and meetings, in your pocket.
products.pitch: A public page that brings you leads on WhatsApp, and a private office where your clients, meetings, quotes and to-dos live. It reminds you before every meeting.
products.for: Insurance agents, property agents, SACCO and sales reps

proof.label: agiza.odhis.co.ke
proof.note: Running for a Nairobi insurance agent

features: A page that brings leads
A clean public page with quick answers that hand visitors straight to your WhatsApp.
Your private office
Clients, meetings, quotes and to-dos behind your own email and password.
Reminders on your phone
A notification, with its own sound, before every meeting and to-do.
Quotes kept safe
Quote PDFs are stored privately. Only you can open them.
An assistant you can talk to
Say or type “meeting with Wanjiru kesho saa nne” and it fills the form. It always confirms before saving.
Installs like an app
It sits on your home screen and opens like any other app.
faq: Is my client list private?
Yes. Your data is locked to your account, and nobody else can read it, not even other users of the product.
Does it work on my phone?
Yes. It's made for phones first, and reminders arrive as phone notifications.
Can my whole team use it?
Today it's built for one person. Team access, with shared clients and roles, is a custom build.
Does the assistant use AI?
No. It follows clear rules, understands some Swahili, and never saves anything without showing you first.

products.name: Campus Board
products.line: Every free room on campus, right now.
products.pitch: It reads the official timetable and shows which lecture rooms are free this hour. Lecturers can check in to claim a room, so nobody walks the corridors looking.

proof.label: Being built for Chiromo campus
proof.note: 72 rooms and 630 classes already loaded from the timetable

features: Reads the real timetable
Classes are imported from the official timetable files, not typed in by hand.
Free rooms by the hour
See at a glance which rooms are empty now and later today.
Check in to claim a room
Lecturers claim a free room so two classes don't land in the same place.
Campus sign-in
Only people with a university email can check in.
faq: When will it be ready?
It's being built now for Chiromo campus. Join the waitlist and you'll hear the moment it opens.
Does it work for other campuses?
Yes. Any campus that publishes a timetable can use it. We set up the import for yours.
Do we need the university's permission?
It reads the published timetable. For a full launch, we work with the department.

products.name: Remember
products.pitch: Keep a list of your customers' birthdays and Remember sends each one a personal WhatsApp wish on the day, through WhatsApp's official business service.
products.for: Salons, shops, gyms and any business that wants customers to come back

proof.label: Uses WhatsApp's official business service
proof.note: Built and tested, waiting on WhatsApp business setup

features: Wishes on the day
Every morning it sends the day's birthday wishes, once per person per year.
Official WhatsApp
It uses WhatsApp's own business service, not a hack, so your number stays safe.
Your own list
A simple private page where you add and edit customers.
Retries if it fails
If a message doesn't go through, it tries again before giving up.
faq: Will my WhatsApp get banned?
No. It uses WhatsApp's official business service, which exists for exactly this. It needs a WhatsApp Business setup, and we help with that.
Does each message cost money?
Yes, a few shillings per message, charged by WhatsApp (Meta), not by us. We show you the current rate before you start.
Can it message anyone?
Only customers who agreed to hear from you. That's WhatsApp's rule, and it's also good manners.
